name: BoTab
description: A tab and bookmark manager for Chrome and Edge. Save open tabs in one click and turn your bookmarks into a customizable new tab page, generated locally with native browser sync.
description_zh: Chrome 和 Edge 的标签页与书签管理工具。一键保存打开的标签页，用书签生成可自定义的新标签页；页面在本地生成，数据通过浏览器原生书签同步。

images.alt: BoTab new tab page with bookmark groups and saved tabs
images.alt_zh: BoTab 新标签页中的书签分组与已保存标签页

images.alt: BoTab theme gallery and new tab customization
images.alt_zh: BoTab 主题库与新标签页自定义设置

name: Viora
description: A voice AI assistant for macOS. Speak to write in any app, edit selected text, ask questions in context, and hand off tasks without leaving your workflow.
description_zh: macOS 语音 AI 助手。按住快捷键说话，即可在当前应用中输入、改写选中文字、结合上下文提问，或交办任务。

images.alt: Viora voice dictation and core features tutorial
images.alt_zh: Viora 语音输入与核心功能引导

images.alt: Viora drafting an email reply in the Agent Card
images.alt_zh: Viora 在 Agent Card 中起草邮件回复

images.alt: Viora answering a question with a comparison table
images.alt_zh: Viora 用对比表格回答问题
